تزاحمت (form VI)
# تَزَاحَمْتُ (tazāḥamtu) /ta.zaː.ħam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# تَزَاحَمْتَ (tazāḥamta) /ta.zaː.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# تَزَاحَمْتِ (tazāḥamti) /ta.zaː.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# تَزَاحَمَتْ (tazāḥamat) /ta.zaː.ħa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
